name: 63332 · Augusta, MO
findings: ZIP 63332 (Augusta) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (86% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63332 (Augusta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
